description: Search public software requests. USE WHEN (a) a user is unsatisfied with existing software and you need to check for a similar request before creating one, or (b) a creator wants to discover demand to find or build software for. Optional keyword query, status and platform filters. NO side effects; public. Similar requests are suggestions: compare must_have constraints before treating two requests as the same need. A resolved request carries `resolved_by`, the software its requester accepted.

offset.description: Items to skip; use next_offset from the previous page.

platform.description: Only requests targeting this platform, e.g. 'ios'.

requested_by.description: Only requests published by this user: the `owner.id` of a request.

sort.description: 'updated' = most recently changed first; with status 'resolved' that is the most recently resolved.

name: search_requests
title: Search requests
